The '''Veterans' Mental Care Hospital''' on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] cared for former members of the various branches of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance's]] armed forces. In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Unidentified Quarren employee|employee]] was [[Force phantom|possessed]] while on duty and asleep on the job by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]] [[Lumiya]].
